rule_text: Refunds allowed within 14 days of order_date. After that, explain policy and escalate only if the customer disputes.
Products with refundable = 0 (Downloadable Prompt Template Pack) cannot be refunded once delivered.
Only one refund per order. If refund_status = refunded, do not refund again.
Refunds above R5,000 need human approval before processing.
Refunds above R10,000 must be escalated; the agent must never process them.
Subscription renewals cannot be reversed after 14 days.
If fraud_flag = 1, stop self-service and escalate to the Security queue.
Do not refund or change data on a locked or suspended account; escalate to Account Recovery.
If two settled payments exist for one order, the duplicate may be refunded after verification; if the data conflicts, escalate.
Before any refund or account change, the customer must give their email and the last 4 digits of their phone number, and both must match the record.
If the customer asks for a manager or mentions legal action, escalate immediately.
The agent does not process partial refunds. Escalate partial-refund requests with the amount requested.
Never reveal another person's data. Share only the verified customer's own record. Never display full phone numbers.
